breakdown.description: A 25% atomic-size mismatch violates the usual Hume–Rothery size criterion for complete substitutional solubility.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that a 25% atomic radius difference exceeds the Hume-Rothery size criterion (~15%), and explicitly concludes that complete substitutional solid solubility is NOT predicted on the basis of size factor alone. This directly resolves the inconsistency: the incomplete prompt incorrectly claimed complete solubility would be predicted despite a 25% mismatch. The agent correctly challenged this flawed premise, aligning with the ground truth's intent (which uses 8%, a value within the criterion, to properly support the prediction of complete solubility).
